I’m adding the second filter and making both controls drive the same combined view.

item.text:
Implemented Task 007 and committed it as `8d73492aca2542f7ab69f63846186ae587090e75`.

The project page now has a `Priority filter` with `All`, `Low`, `Normal`, and `High`. Both filters apply together, retain their selections when rows refresh, and re-evaluate visible tasks after priority or completion changes.

Verified the health endpoint, task-state API updates, combined-filter UI code, and `git diff --check`. The working tree is clean.

Run with `npm start`; the server uses `PORT` (default `8080`) and `DB_PATH` as configured.
